item.title: Sweetwater gears up for 68th annual Rattlesnake Roundup
item.description: SWEETWATER, Texas (KTAB/KRBC) - The small West Texas town of Sweetwater is preparing for the 68th annual World’s Largest Rattlesnake Roundup, a tradition that has been part of the community for nearly seven decades.
